title: Naturality of the component-characterized additive local comparison
statement: Let C,R satisfy [def-per-local-rhom-normalization-interface], let U be an object and n an integer, let s:Iprime to I and t:Lprime to L be chain maps, with Iprime and I K-injective. Under the additive canonical comparison of [lem-per-local-rhom-additive-cocycle-comparison], the map on section cohomology induced by Hom(t,s) is precomposition by Q(res t) and postcomposition by Q((res s)[n]). This is an equation for the fixed component-characterized equivalences, not merely existence of unspecified equivalences.

proof.text: Lift a homology class to a cycle, using surjectivity of the homology projection in abelian groups. The component equations characterizing the chosen cycle equivalences and the Hom-bifunctor projection formula show that the image cycle is the precomposition by the restricted source map and postcomposition by the restricted target map. Apply cohomologyEquiv_π on both sides. The identities equivHomShift_symm_precomp and equivHomShift_symm_postcomp identify the corresponding chain maps; Q.map_comp gives the displayed derived equation. Reuse homObjMap_section_component from the existing universe-general homotopy naturality module; the lemma is exposed there rather than duplicated here. Only its componentwise-composition identity is used, not the existential homotopy comparison.
